senses.zh_definition: Alvin，通常用作男性名字；中文译名应以本人采用的姓名为准。
senses.en_definition: Alvin, a personal name usually given to males.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas peribadi yang lazimnya diberikan kepada lelaki.

etymology.historical_story: Alvin has several related Germanic naming histories. English forms are associated with older names including Ælfwine, Æðelwine and Ealdwine; Scandinavian usage also connects it with Alfvin. These histories do not make Alvin a Malay compound. In a Malay sentence, it identifies a person rather than expressing an ordinary dictionary meaning. See [Alvin's naming history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/alvin).
